system.description:
Make a Quick Attack with +1 to its attack roll and -1 to its base damage. This Skill gains a different additional effect based on its Trigger.

  • Light Trigger: If both this Skill and the Trigger landed, your Flow is raised by 1.
  • Heavy Trigger: Deal +3 additional damage.
  • Grab Trigger: If the preceding Trigger was successful, this attack gains [Sunder], but the grapple is released.
